$comment: Single source of truth for the MIDI Glass installer version.
MIDI Glass is its own release train, separate from the App SDK (build/version.json) and
the service plugins (build/version-plugins.json). build-all.ps1 stamps this into
build/staging/version/MidiGlassVersion.wxi, which only the MIDI Glass installer reads.
0.9.0-preview.1. Bump 'patch' for each release; that is what distinguishes builds.
build:         4th field of the numeric MSI version only. It does NOT appear in the SemVer
string. CI can override with -BuildNumber <n> without touching this file;
IMPORTANT: Windows Installer only compares the first THREE fields of a version.
Bump 'patch' for any release that must upgrade over a previously installed one.
